# Existing detectors

Ports today rely on radar for the drone body and on spotters with binoculars for everything else. Radar does not see a tether. A few power-line operators fly warning markers on their lines, which helps a pilot but does nothing about a hostile or careless tether near the lines.

Nobody sells a sensor shaped for one crane row that finds the tether itself.

Prior art on thin line detection is probably held as patents, not papers. The room needs that patent literature before it claims the gap.
